parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参考文档《[如何保证幂等性](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence)》。

parameters.name: CloudAccountVendorType
parameters.description:
云账号类型。取值可选范围：

- alibaba_cloud：阿里云

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-cloud-account --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --cloud-account-name cloud_accout_xxxx --cloud-account-vendor-type Alibaba_cloud_Alibaba_Cloud --cloud-account-external-id 1234567 --cloud-account-provider-name idaas-eiam-oidc-provider --description cloud_accout_description --client-token client-token-example --cloud-account-site china_mainland --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateCloudAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CloudAccountVendorType Alibaba_cloud_Alibaba_Cloud --Description cloud_accout_description --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --CloudAccountName cloud_accout_xxxx --CloudAccountSite china_mainland --CloudAccountExternalId 1234567 --CloudAccountProviderName 'idaas-eiam-oidc-provider' --ClientToken 'client-token-example'
